text: The authors generate arguments by having two instances of a large pretrained model, randomly assigned the correct and incorrect answer to a question, take turns reviewing earlier arguments and arguing for their side; after a fixed number of turns (three in this work) the debate ends and the transcript is kept. Each debater presents the most compelling evidence for its answer and argues why its opponent's claims are false.
title: Argument generation by debate between two instances of a strong pretrained model
